title: Mineshield-Axe
body:
Mineshield Axes is a client-side Fabric mod that adds unique weapons with specialized combat functions. The mod synchronizes actions between players via hidden chat messages—these are sent automatically in the background, allowing the mod to work on vanilla servers without additional plugins.
⚠️ CRITICAL NOTE: This is a client-side mod. If your opponent does not have the mod installed, they will not see the custom axe models, visual effects, or experience specific debuffs (like blindness or control inversion). The mod’s full potential is only realized when both combatants have it active.
Acquisition and Mechanics:
To create a weapon, take any item and rename it in an Anvil to "Топор Дровосека" (must be in Russian Cyrillic). The item’s model will instantly transform into a golden axe. To imbue it with a function, add the specific name in parentheses:

    Топор Дровосека (Альфёдов): Press RMB to ignite a 5x5 area of custom blue soul fire and particles around the user.
    Топор Дровосека (Джаст): Upon a hit, the victim's screen goes dark and all entities (players/mobs) vanish for 10 seconds. Only works if the victim also has the mod.
    Топор Дровосека (Секби): Upon a hit, the target is completely stunned, losing all ability to move or fight back for the duration.
    Топор Дровосека (Кактус): Upon a hit, the victim's movement controls are inverted. For example, pressing "Forward" will move the player "Backward," completely disrupting their coordination.
    Топор Дровосека (Альцест): Upon a hit, a lightning bolt strikes the target, and the server immediately disconnects (kicks) them from the game.
